mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users (username, email, password_hash, role, status, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{username}, #{email}, #{passwordHash}, #{role}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE users SET username = #{username}, email = #{email}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, role = #{role}, status = #{status}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT user_id, username, email, password_hash, role, status, created_at, updated_at FROM users ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = #{username})
SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE email = #{email})
